title: Sustainext Agentic AI
desc: Designed an AI-powered conversational experience for the Sustainext ESG platform — helping users identify workflow gaps, update ESG data, and generate report-ready outputs through intelligent task-based guidance.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content:
Sustainext Agentic AI is an AI-powered experience designed to simplify ESG data management and reporting workflows within the Sustainext platform.

The project focused on helping users quickly identify missing information, resolve workflow gaps, and generate report-ready outputs through intelligent conversational interactions and task-based AI assistance.

The platform combines predefined prompts, contextual recommendations, and categorised AI modules to guide users efficiently through ESG-related tasks while reducing manual effort.

images.caption: Sustainext Agent — welcome screen with AI query input

sections.title: Problem Statement
sections.content:
Managing ESG data across large enterprise platforms can become time-consuming and complex due to fragmented workflows, incomplete information, and difficulty navigating multiple modules.

Users needed a more guided and efficient way to identify missing data, understand workflow gaps, and complete reporting tasks without relying heavily on manual processes or platform expertise.
bulletPoints: Complex ESG workflow management with fragmented data spread across modules
Difficulty identifying missing information and understanding workflow gaps
High dependency on manual navigation and reporting processes
Lack of guided task completion for non-technical enterprise users

sections.title: My Role
sections.content: I worked as the UI/UX Designer responsible for designing the overall AI-assisted user experience — from structuring conversational workflows and task-based modules to building the dashboard interface and ensuring the experience remained intuitive at enterprise scale.
bulletPoints: AI experience & conversational UX design
Dashboard and control tower interface design
Information architecture and task flow structuring
Prompt library experience design
High-fidelity UI design in Figma

sections.title: Design Process
sections.content: The process focused on simplifying ESG workflows through guided AI interactions and structured task-based experiences — designed to feel supportive and efficient rather than overly technical.

images.caption: Supply Chain Gap Assessment — AI-guided task flow with contextual action prompts

steps.name: Workflow Understanding
steps.desc: Reviewed ESG workflows, reporting requirements, and user pain points across the platform.

steps.name: AI Task Structuring
steps.desc: Categorised workflows into task-based AI modules for clearer navigation and targeted assistance.

steps.name: Conversational Design
steps.desc: Designed guided conversational flows with actionable insights and recommended next steps.

steps.name: Dashboard Design
steps.desc: Created control tower dashboards to monitor AI feature usage and workflow activity.

steps.name: Refinement
steps.desc: Improved information hierarchy, interaction clarity, and overall usability across the platform.

sections.title: Key Design Decisions
sections.highlightText: Designed an AI-assisted workflow experience that simplifies ESG reporting through intelligent guidance and actionable insights — structured around tasks, not just conversation.
bulletPoints: **Task-based model over generic chatbot** — AI organised around specific workflow tasks for more relevant, actionable guidance
**Integrated prompt library** — predefined prompts reduce user effort and improve task completion speed
**Contextual recommendations** — surfaced relevant next steps based on the user's current workflow state
**Centralised usage dashboard** — control tower view for monitoring AI activity across the platform

sections.title: Outcome
sections.content:
The final solution created a more guided and efficient ESG workflow experience — helping users identify missing information, complete reporting tasks faster, and access actionable insights more easily.

The AI-assisted experience improved workflow accessibility for enterprise users and helped clients interact with ESG processes in a more structured and user-friendly way.

images.caption: Control Tower View — live AI credit usage and module analytics dashboard

sections.title: Key Learnings
sections.content:
This project deepened my understanding of designing AI-assisted enterprise experiences and balancing conversational interactions with structured workflow systems.

Key insight: effective AI UX isn't about building smarter chatbots — it's about designing task-oriented experiences that give users confidence and reduce friction at every step.

title: AIVAS — AI Voice Assistance System
desc: Designed an AI-powered defence intelligence platform that streamlines audio transcription, translation, and insight extraction through a unified and efficient user workflow.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content:
AIVAS (Artificial Intelligence Voice Assistance System) is a defence-focused SaaS platform designed to simplify the analysis of multilingual audio files through AI-powered transcription, translation, and insight extraction.

The platform was created to help users quickly identify critical information from uploaded audio recordings while reducing manual effort and improving operational efficiency. The system combines multiple complex workflows into a single streamlined experience, enabling users to access categorized outputs, translated transcripts, and extracted insights from one unified interface.

The primary design goal was to create a clean, efficient, and easy-to-navigate workflow for handling large volumes of audio data with minimal user interaction.

images.caption: Single audio analysis — upload workflow with transcription and insight extraction

bulletPoints: AI-powered audio intelligence platform for defence workflows
Supports transcription and multilingual translation
Bulk audio upload functionality for large-scale processing
Categorized insights surfaced in a unified dashboard
Optimized for operational efficiency with minimal interaction
Designed specifically for defence-focused use cases

sections.title: Problem Statement
sections.content:
The existing workflow for analyzing audio intelligence data involved fragmented processes, multiple tools, and time-consuming manual interactions. Users had to switch between different systems for transcription, translation, and information extraction, making the overall experience inefficient and difficult to manage at scale.

Another major challenge was handling large volumes of audio files while ensuring users could quickly access the most relevant insights based on operational priorities.

The goal was to simplify this experience into a single structured workflow that reduced cognitive load and improved accessibility to critical information.
bulletPoints: Disconnected workflows spread across multiple tools and systems
Time-consuming manual processing with limited automation
Difficulty managing and prioritizing large audio datasets
Inefficient information retrieval during high-priority operations
High interaction complexity creating unnecessary cognitive load

sections.title: My Role
sections.content:
I worked as the sole UI/UX designer for the project and was responsible for designing the complete user experience from concept to final interface design.

I collaborated closely with stakeholders to understand workflow requirements, define information hierarchy, and create a scalable dashboard experience focused on usability and operational clarity.
bulletPoints: End-to-end UI/UX design ownership
User flow planning and journey mapping
Dashboard architecture and layout design
Information hierarchy and content structuring
Interaction design and micro-UX decisions
Design system consistency across all screens
High-fidelity UI creation in Figma

sections.title: Design Process
sections.content: The design process focused on simplifying complex AI-powered workflows into a more structured and intuitive user experience. Since the platform handled multiple outputs simultaneously, the primary focus was on organizing information clearly while reducing unnecessary user interactions.

steps.name: Requirement Understanding
steps.desc: Reviewed workflow expectations, operational requirements, and output priorities with stakeholders.

steps.name: Information Structuring
steps.desc: Organised transcription, translation, and extracted insights into a clear and scannable content hierarchy.

steps.name: Workflow Simplification
steps.desc: Reduced interaction complexity by consolidating multiple actions into a single unified experience.

steps.name: Dashboard UI Design
steps.desc: Designed a structured interface optimised for readability, accessibility, and quick information scanning.

steps.name: Final UI Refinement
steps.desc: Refined layouts, spacing, and component consistency for a polished and coherent enterprise experience.

sections.title: Key Design Decisions

images.caption: Unified output view — transcription, translation and extracted insights on a single screen

sections.content:
One of the key design decisions was to centralize all important outputs within a single interface instead of distributing them across multiple screens. This helped reduce navigation effort and allowed users to compare transcription, translation, and extracted insights more efficiently.

Another important decision was implementing categorized information sections to improve readability and help users prioritize critical outputs quickly. The bulk upload feature was also designed to minimize repetitive actions and improve workflow scalability.

Special attention was given to maintaining a clean visual hierarchy despite the high density of information displayed on screen.
sections.highlightText: Designed to simplify complex audio intelligence workflows into a faster and more accessible user experience.
bulletPoints: **Unified single-screen workflow** — all outputs consolidated to eliminate cross-screen navigation
**Reduced interaction complexity** — fewer steps between upload and insight access
**Prioritized information hierarchy** — critical data surfaced at the top of each view
**Scalable bulk-upload experience** — supports large audio volumes without repetitive actions
**Improved content readability** — clear typographic and spatial hierarchy throughout
**Structured enterprise dashboard layout** — designed for operational density without cognitive overload

sections.title: Outcome
sections.content:
The final solution created a more streamlined and efficient workflow for handling multilingual audio intelligence data. By consolidating transcription, translation, and insight extraction into one unified experience, the platform reduced operational complexity and improved accessibility to key information.

The project was positively appreciated for delivering a cleaner and more user-friendly experience compared to previous workflows, especially in handling large-scale audio processing tasks more efficiently.
bulletPoints: Improved overall workflow efficiency for audio intelligence tasks
Faster access to extracted insights and translated transcripts
Reduced manual interaction and repetitive navigation
Better information organisation across high-density screens
Simplified large-scale audio processing from upload to output
Positive stakeholder feedback on usability and clarity

sections.title: Key Learnings
sections.content:
This project strengthened my understanding of designing enterprise workflows that involve complex data processing and high information density. It also helped me improve my approach to structuring AI-driven outputs in a way that feels organized, accessible, and easy to navigate.

One of the biggest learnings was balancing functionality with simplicity — especially when designing for operational use cases where speed and accuracy both matter.

title: Reach My Movie
desc: Designed a B2B entertainment platform that enables film producers to directly connect with theater owners, manage movie releases, track performance insights, and customize theater show operations without relying on distributors.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content:
Reach My Movie is a B2B platform designed to simplify collaboration between film producers and theater owners by eliminating the dependency on traditional distributors.

The platform enables producers to directly manage movie releases, monitor performance across different cities, customize show schedules, and communicate with theater owners through a centralized system.

The goal of the project was to create a streamlined digital experience that improves operational visibility, simplifies coordination, and gives producers more control over movie distribution and performance tracking.
bulletPoints: Direct producer-to-theater collaboration without intermediaries
Movie performance tracking across tier cities and regions
Customizable theater show scheduling and management
Centralized communication workflow between stakeholders
Revenue and income monitoring for producers
Distributor-free operational model

sections.title: Problem Statement
sections.content:
Traditional movie distribution workflows heavily rely on intermediaries, making communication between producers and theater owners slower and less transparent. Producers often face challenges in tracking movie performance across different regions, managing show schedules efficiently, and accessing operational insights in real time.

The absence of a centralized platform also created inefficiencies in coordination, reporting, and decision-making for both producers and theater owners.

The project aimed to simplify this ecosystem by creating a direct and structured collaboration platform.
bulletPoints: Heavy dependency on distributors slowing down collaboration
Limited transparency in movie performance across regions
Inefficient communication workflows between stakeholders
Difficulty managing theater show operations at scale
Lack of a centralized reporting and analytics system
Limited producer control over show customization

sections.title: My Role
sections.content:
I worked as the UI/UX Designer for the project and contributed from the initial concept stage to the final design delivery. My responsibilities included logo design, product interface design, dashboard structuring, workflow planning, and creating a consistent visual experience across the platform.

I collaborated closely with stakeholders to understand operational requirements and transform complex workflows into a more structured and intuitive platform experience.
bulletPoints: End-to-end UI/UX design
Logo and visual identity design
Dashboard architecture and layout design
User flow planning and journey structuring
Information architecture across multiple user roles
High-fidelity UI creation in Figma
Design system and component consistency
Final design handoff and delivery

sections.title: Design Process
sections.content:
The design process focused on simplifying operational workflows between producers and theater owners while ensuring the platform remained easy to navigate and scalable for different business needs.

The platform required balancing multiple functionalities — communication, movie performance tracking, revenue visibility, and show customization — within a structured and accessible interface. Special attention was given to clear information hierarchy and reducing workflow friction for users managing large-scale movie operations.

images.caption: Theater slot selection — show scheduling and customization workflow for theater owners

steps.name: Requirement Gathering
steps.desc: Understood business workflows, stakeholder expectations, and operational pain points for both producers and theater owners.

steps.name: Workflow Structuring
steps.desc: Planned user flows for producers and theater owners to ensure smoother end-to-end collaboration.

steps.name: Dashboard Planning
steps.desc: Organised reporting, movie tracking, and show customization features into a scalable and navigable interface.

steps.name: Visual Design

steps.name: Final Design Delivery

sections.title: Key Design Decisions
sections.content:
One of the major design decisions was creating a centralized dashboard that allows producers to monitor movie performance and theater operations from a single interface. This reduced dependency on fragmented communication and improved visibility across multiple locations.

Another important decision was designing flexible show customization workflows so theater owners could efficiently manage schedules while maintaining coordination with producers.

The interface was intentionally kept structured and data-focused to support quick decision-making and operational clarity.
sections.highlightText: Designed to simplify movie distribution workflows through direct collaboration and operational visibility.
bulletPoints: **Centralized operational dashboard** — single interface for monitoring performance across all locations
**Simplified producer–theater communication** — direct messaging reducing reliance on external channels
**Flexible show customization** — theater owners can manage schedules without back-and-forth coordination
**Performance visibility across cities** — real-time tracking of revenue and attendance by region
**Structured data hierarchy** — critical metrics surfaced at a glance for faster decisions
**Clean enterprise-focused UI system** — consistent and scalable across all platform sections

sections.title: Outcome
sections.content:
The final platform created a more streamlined and transparent workflow for movie distribution and theater collaboration. By enabling direct interaction between producers and theater owners, the solution reduced operational complexity and improved access to performance insights.

The project was also recognized for its uniqueness and innovation, leading to the platform being patented by the client.

images.caption: Revenue dashboard — producer's performance and income tracking across regions

bulletPoints: Improved operational transparency across the distribution workflow
Simplified collaboration between producers and theater owners
Better visibility into movie performance and revenue metrics
Streamlined theater management and show scheduling
Reduced dependency on intermediaries
Platform recognized as innovative and patented by the client

title: MIK — Knowledge Repository
desc: Designed an AI-powered knowledge repository platform that helps organizations quickly access relevant documents, generate summarized insights, and streamline policy and rule creation through intelligent search and conversational interactions.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content:
MIK (Knowledge Repository) is an AI-powered enterprise platform designed to simplify document discovery, policy research, and knowledge accessibility within large organizational systems.

The platform enables users to search through large volumes of documents using conversational AI interactions and receive summarized responses along with relevant document references based on their queries.

The primary goal was to reduce the time spent manually reviewing documents and improve the efficiency of policy creation and decision-making workflows.
bulletPoints: AI-powered document discovery through conversational search
Summarized AI-generated responses with source references
Centralized document repository with structured navigation
Role-based document access for organizational control
Admin dashboard for document uploads and management
Designed for government and enterprise-scale operations

sections.title: Problem Statement
sections.content:
Organizations managing large volumes of documents often face challenges in quickly locating relevant information required for creating policies, guidelines, and operational rules.

The existing process involved manually reviewing multiple documents, which increased research time, slowed decision-making, and made information retrieval inefficient.

The project aimed to simplify knowledge accessibility by introducing an AI-powered conversational system capable of retrieving related documents and generating summarized insights based on user queries.
bulletPoints: Time-consuming manual document research across large repositories
Difficulty locating relevant information quickly under operational pressure
Repetitive review of multiple files to extract key information
Slow policy and guideline creation due to fragmented knowledge access
Inefficient knowledge accessibility across departments
Delayed decision-making caused by poor information discoverability

sections.title: My Role
sections.content:
I worked as the UI/UX Designer for the project and was responsible for designing the end-to-end experience for both the AI-assisted search interface and the administrative document management workflows.

My responsibilities included designing conversational search interactions, dashboard experiences, document access workflows, and ensuring the platform remained structured, accessible, and easy to navigate for enterprise users.
bulletPoints: End-to-end UI/UX design
Conversational AI search experience design
Admin dashboard and document management UX
Document access workflow structuring
Information architecture and repository navigation
Admin panel and permissions UX
Interaction design and user flow planning
High-fidelity UI design in Figma

sections.title: Design Process
sections.content:
The design process focused on simplifying how users discover and interact with organizational knowledge across large document repositories.

A major focus was creating a conversational experience that feels intuitive while ensuring users can quickly access summarized insights and related documents without navigating through complex folder structures. Special attention was also given to designing scalable admin workflows for document management, access control, and repository maintenance.

images.caption: Document management — admin workflow for uploading, categorising and controlling document access

steps.name: Workflow Understanding
steps.desc: Reviewed existing document management and policy research workflows to identify friction points.

steps.name: Search Experience Planning
steps.desc: Structured AI-driven conversational flows to enable faster and more natural knowledge retrieval.

steps.name: Information Architecture
steps.desc: Organised document categories, access structures, and repository navigation for scalability.

steps.name: Admin Workflow Design
steps.desc: Designed dashboards for document uploads, access permissions, and usage monitoring.

steps.name: Final UI Refinement
steps.desc: Refined layouts, interaction clarity, and enterprise usability across all platform screens.

sections.title: Key Design Decisions
sections.content:
One of the key design decisions was presenting AI-generated summaries alongside related document references to help users quickly validate information without manually reviewing multiple files.

Another important decision was implementing role-based document access and categorized repository structures to improve usability and maintain better information control within the platform.

The conversational search experience was intentionally designed to feel structured and professional while supporting faster knowledge discovery.
sections.highlightText: Designed to transform complex document research into a faster and more accessible AI-assisted experience.
bulletPoints: **Conversational AI search** — natural query-based discovery replacing manual folder navigation
**AI-generated summaries with source references** — users validate quickly without opening every document
**Related document recommendations** — contextual suggestions to support deeper exploration
**Structured repository organization** — categorized for faster browsing across large archives
**Role-based access management** — controlled visibility tailored to organizational hierarchy
**Enterprise-focused admin dashboard** — clear controls for uploads, permissions, and usage monitoring

sections.title: Outcome
sections.content:
The final solution improved how users access organizational knowledge by reducing manual research effort and making document discovery more efficient.

The AI-assisted experience helped users retrieve relevant information faster, access summarized insights quickly, and support decision-making workflows more effectively within a centralized platform.

Due to the confidential nature of the government project, only selected workflows and interface experiences can be publicly showcased.
bulletPoints: Reduced time spent on manual document research
Faster decision-making through AI-generated summaries
Improved knowledge accessibility across the organization
Simplified document discovery and policy creation workflows
Better information organization within the repository
Enhanced enterprise usability for government-scale operations

sections.title: AI Search Experience
sections.content:
The conversational AI experience was designed to simplify how users interact with large document repositories by allowing natural query-based searches instead of traditional manual navigation methods.

The system provides summarized insights along with related document references, helping users quickly understand relevant information and continue deeper exploration when required.

images.caption: Conversational AI search — natural language query with summarised insights and document references

bulletPoints: Conversational document discovery through natural language queries
AI-generated summaries reducing time-to-insight
Contextual document recommendations based on query relevance
Faster information retrieval without navigating folder hierarchies
Simplified knowledge exploration for non-technical enterprise users

sections.title: Key Learnings
sections.content:
This project strengthened my understanding of designing AI-assisted enterprise workflows that involve large-scale information management and structured knowledge accessibility.

It also helped me improve my approach to balancing conversational UX with enterprise-level usability, security, and information hierarchy requirements.
